sadist.about: Enjoys giving intense sensation — including pain — in consensual play. A sadist gets pleasure from their partner's reactions, and scenes are negotiated in advance with clear limits and consent.

rigger.name: Rigger
rigger.about: Enjoys tying a partner up with rope, often in Shibari-style bondage. A rigger focuses on technique, safety, and the shared experience of restraint, treating rope as both craft and connection.

brat.about: A playful submissive who teases, talks back, or pushes back against a dominant — not to refuse, but to invite a response. The defiance is part of the game, and it only works when both partners enjoy the back-and-forth.

brat-tamer.name: Brat Tamer
brat-tamer.about: Enjoys meeting a brat's playful defiance with control and discipline. A brat tamer likes the challenge of the pushback and the fun of bringing a brat back into line, consensually.

dominant.name: Dominant
dominant.about: Takes charge and directs the scene, setting the pace, the rules, and the activities. A dominant enjoys the responsibility and control of leading a partner who has consented to follow.

service-submissive.name: Service Submissive
service-submissive.about: Finds fulfillment in serving a partner's needs — through acts of service, attentiveness, and devotion. The pleasure comes from being useful and pleasing a partner, rather than from pain or restraint.

exhibitionist.name: Exhibitionist
exhibitionist.about: Enjoys being seen or watched during intimate or kinky play, whether by a partner, a group, or an audience. The thrill comes from being observed and desired.

voyeur.name: Voyeur
voyeur.about: Enjoys watching others during intimate or kinky play, with everyone's knowledge and consent. The pleasure comes from observing rather than participating directly.

degradee.name: Degradee
degradee.about: Enjoys consensual degradation or humiliation — being talked down to, used, or belittled in a scene. What looks harsh from outside is negotiated, wanted, and stops the moment consent is withdrawn.

degrader.name: Degrader
degrader.about: Enjoys delivering consensual degradation or humiliation — teasing, belittling, or using a partner in a scene. A degrader enjoys the power of the words, and it only happens within limits the degradee has agreed to.

primal.name: Primal
primal.about: Drawn to raw, instinctive, animalistic play — growling, wrestling, biting, and chasing, with less talk and structure than a formal scene. Primal play is about letting instinct lead, within agreed boundaries.

prey.name: Prey
prey.about: Enjoys being pursued, hunted, and caught in primal play. The thrill is in the chase and the capture — being overpowered by a partner who is playing the predator, consensually.

switch.name: Switch
switch.about: Enjoys both dominant and submissive roles, and moves between them — sometimes within a single scene, sometimes from partner to partner. A switch finds pleasure in both giving up control and taking it.

cuckold.name: Cuckold
cuckold.about: Enjoys their partner being intimate with someone else, with everyone's knowledge and consent. The appeal can be the voyeurism, the humiliation, the compersion, or some mix of the three.

sensation-seeker.name: Sensation Seeker

edge-player.name: Edge Player
edge-player.about: Plays at the edge of limits — with riskier activities that need extra care, knowledge, and negotiation. Edge play is defined by its risk, so it demands more preparation, communication, and risk awareness than other kinds of play.

I'm a submissive. Not a role — the thing I am. I need to be owned, directed, told what to do. The structure of power exchange is where I'm most myself.

I'm drawn to intensity with boundaries. I want to be pushed, used, put in my place — and I want it negotiated, named, and held. The trust matters as much as the act. I give up control, but I don't give up my voice.

I'm an exhibitionist. Being seen turns me on — the vulnerability of it, the being-known. I stream with my partner; being watched isn't a kink I hide.

I'm curious and still discovering. Age play, pet play — I'm exploring what it means to be small, kept, handled. I don't have it all figured out, and I'm honest about that.

What I need from a partner: directness. Tell me what you want. Don't hint, don't dance around it. I respond to clarity and confidence. And after — I need the landing. The check-in, the holding, the confirmation that what we did mattered.

Hard limits: blood, needles, branding, scat, fear play. Anything that causes real harm or doesn't wash off. I want intensity, not injury.
